collection.filter: operation['task'] == 'remap' and operation['remap_source']['source'] == 'prediction_collections' and any(c['model']['type'] == 'raycloudtools' for c in [operation['remap_source']['first_prediction_collection']] + operation['remap_source']['segmented_collections'])

collection.name: output_remap_tree_meshes
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Tree meshes per original
collection.filter: operation['task'] == 'remap' and operation['remap_source']['source'] == 'prediction_collections' and any(c['model']['type'] == 'raycloudtools' for c in [operation['remap_source']['first_prediction_collection']] + operation['remap_source']['segmented_collections'])

collection.label: ${tool.name}: Merged LAZ/COPC
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == 'create_merged_file' and ('laz' in operation['merged_output_formats'] or 'copc.laz' in operation['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] == 'remap' and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == 'True' and ('laz' in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or 'copc.laz' in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']))

collection.label: ${tool.name}: Merged PLY

tool.help:
**What it does**
SmartTile splits point clouds into tiles for segmentation and species models, puts the predicted tiles back together and transfers the predictions onto the original files.
- **Tile and subsample**: buffered spatial tiles at one or more voxel sizes, or tiles in which every existing tree stays whole. Also writes a tile bounds JSON and a preview image. - **Filter / merge segmented tiles**: removes the buffer overlap between segmented tiles and joins trees cut by tile borders. The remap target either transfers the predictions onto finer subsampled tiles first, or also writes the original files with the predictions, like Remap. - **Remap predictions to originals**: copies the predicted dimensions from one or more prediction collections, or one merged file, onto the original files. Every original point must be covered. - **Create merged file**: joins several prediction sets of the same originals into one LAZ, COPC LAZ or PLY file.
Inputs must use a projected CRS in metres. Use the same SmartTile run for tiling and merging.
**Segmentation**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_segmentation.png :width: 100%
Tile the originals at 10 cm for the model and at 1 cm as high-resolution targets. Merge the segmented tiles with the tile bounds JSON (**Remap target → Subsampled tiles**), then remap them onto the originals. For a single model without species prediction, **Remap target → Original files** writes the originals with the predictions directly, and Remap is not needed.
**Species per tree**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_whole_instances.png :width: 80%
Tile originals that already carry tree IDs with **Keep existing instances whole**, run the species model, and remap with **Match within the same existing instance**.
**Several models in one file**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_merged_file.png :width: 40%
Remap each model separately, then add each result as a **Collection** of **Create merged file**. All collections must hold the same originals with the same file names. For ForestStructure, choose full resolution, COPC LAZ and **Add OriginalPointIndex**.
